$comment: Play template v1. The Motion Designer agent instantiates this against a scored account: it may fill placeholders only with evidence-backed facts (cited), never invent them.
name: Infrastructure Automation Modernization
objective: Convert virtualization/renewal cost pressure and modernization initiatives into an automation platform evaluation via a low-friction assessment offer.

personas.secondary: Director Platform Engineering / Director IT Operations

thesis_template: {{company}} is under {{trigger_summary}} while operating {{installed_estate}}. Consolidating fragmented automation onto a single platform can {{value_driver}}, timed against {{timing_event}}.

cta.fallback: Benchmark briefing: how peers are automating the virtualization-exit path

seller_cadence.action: Partner seller sends evidence-grounded opening email (approved draft)
Vendor seller engages technical persona with assessment offer
Call attempt referencing the specific trigger, not the product
Value-recap follow-up with one relevant proof point

objections.response_angle: Toil, drift, and bus-factor cost of bespoke scripting vs. platform; keep scripts, orchestrate them
Automation is renewal-agnostic: it de-risks whichever platform decision was made
Assessment is free; output is a business case sized for next cycle

qualification_framework: Named modernization or cost initiative with a timeline
Estate size sufficient for platform economics
Partner has (or can create) a commercial path into the account
escalation_criteria: Positive reply from economic or technical persona, or meeting booked → escalate to business-value assessment workflow.
